lines.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.clcw_line1_signed. UNCLEAR: the model says nothing in the text given says line 15 equals line 11 minus line 14, and that Form 1040-NR is left out without a refusal. i1040sd p. 10, line 1: "Enter the amount from your 2024 Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 15. If the amount would have been a loss if you could enter a negative number on that line, enclose the amount in parentheses". The rendering states the reading recorded in amb.2025.clcw_line1_signed (owner's decision D2(a), 2026-10-27): ask for 2024 lines 11 and 14 as printed and take line 1 as their difference, because the printed line 15 is floored at zero and the worksheet wants the amount before the floor. The identity is printed on the 2024 Form 1040 (sources/2024/f1040 p. 1, line 15: "Subtract line 14 from line 11. If zero or less, enter -0-. This is your taxable income"), a page the review was not given (it had i1040sd pp. 3 and 10 and p550 pp. 102-103), because the line's citation names only the worksheet. Form 1040-NR is outside the tool (this tool prepares Form 1040 or 1040-SR only), so leaving it out changes nothing. Same ruling as the first Stage 20 round. The BUG-0185 change (line 1 shown only when clcw.applies) agrees with p. 10, "Otherwise, you don't have any carryovers", and is not disputed.
